item.text:
Implemented Task 012 and committed as `453334ead09bf8b4d82d3fca89b0e7ab2122461b`.

The app now remembers each task’s position in every project it has belonged to. Returning tasks regain their prior position; first-time arrivals and newly created tasks follow established positions. Existing task fields remain on the task record.

Verified the health endpoint, move-and-return ordering, persistence after a server restart, and `git diff --check`. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start` (`PORT` defaults to `8080`; set `DB_PATH` for the SQLite file).
